evidence.text: Lessor hereby leases to the Government the Premises described herein, being all or a portion of the Property located at [Address]

clauses.heading: Lease Term
clauses.text: To Have and To Hold the said Premises with its appurtenances for the term beginning upon acceptance of the Premises as required by this Lease and continuing for a period of X Years, X Years Firm.

clauses.heading: 1.03 Rent and Other Consideration
clauses.text: The Government must pay the Lessor annual rent, payable in monthly installments in arrears, at the following rates.

clauses.heading: 1.05 Renewal Rights
clauses.text: This Lease may be renewed at the option of the Government for a term of XX YEARS.
